lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then he asked me if I wanted ta come over ta bonfire and I said yeah and then while I was getting' ready, the phone rang again and it was Steven and he asked me if a, if I was gettin' ready.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Then I go over there and we started to pick up the yard with the golf cart.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So you go over there do, you go in the house at that time?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I go right back by the bonfire.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And he, when did you to decide to go get the golf cart?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well he had it over there already.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Oh, did you hear anything outside at that point?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Did he tell you anything at that point? Of what he had done already.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: You've gotta be honest with us here Brendan, OK? This is your opportunity to be honest with us. OK?
